name: gelatinous cube
desc: Gelatinous Cube is a CR 2 ooze.

actions.name: ooze cube
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} takes up its entire space. Other creatures can enter the space, but a creature that does so is subjected to the cube's @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.monsters.Actor.3fzQVYQhXxCXRa2o.Item.6PuULfBzy5vpBSFI]{Engulf} and has disadvantage on the saving throw. Creatures inside the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can be seen but have &reference[total cover]. A creature within 5 feet of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can take an action to pull a creature or object out of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}. Doing so requires a successful [[/check]] check, and the creature making the attempt takes [[/damage average]] damage. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can hold only one Large creature or up to four Medium or smaller creatures inside it at a time.

actions.name: transparent
actions.desc: Even when the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is in plain sight, it takes a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check to spot a cube that has neither moved nor attacked. A creature that tries to enter the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s space while unaware of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is &reference[surprise]{Surprised} by the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}.

actions.name: engulf
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} moves up to its speed. While doing so, it can enter Large or smaller creatures' spaces. Whenever the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} enters a creature's space, the creature must make a [[/save activity=nGINyQKTsYq10OA0]] saving throw. On a successful save, the creature can choose to be pushed 5 feet back or to the side of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}. A creature that chooses not to be pushed suffers the consequences of a failed saving throw. On a failed save, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} enters the creature's space, and the creature takes [[/damage average activity=nGINyQKTsYq10OA0]] damage and is engulfed. The engulfed creature can't &reference[suffocating]{Breathe}, is &reference[restrained], and takes [[/damage average activity=sDRiVB3bhk4S5XZI]] damage at the start of each of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s turns. When the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} moves, the engulfed creature moves with it. An engulfed creature can try to escape by taking an action to make a [[/check activity=LMPyxWOrUotM7OLs]] check. On a success, the creature escapes and enters a space of its choice within 5 feet of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}.
